text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut four 387 mm lengths of 25 x 2 mm tube; round the top end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 10.5 mm across the tube 12 mm from the top: the pivot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 6.5 mm across, 30 mm below the pivot hole: the detent hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld a 60 x 60 x 5 mm foot plate square on the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the top end goes between a pair of 3 mm clevis plates under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rail, 40 mm from the rail end; M10 pivot bolt, nyloc nut,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: snug so the leg swings. Spring detent pin through the clevis

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the leg holds it down; a second clevis hole holds it folded.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The leg folds inward along the rail, foot toward the axle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with all four down the deck is level within 1 degree.
